reviewer: /root/concise_foundations (independent global derivation, implementation, artifact and retention review)

global_derivation.architecture: Widths (1,2,1,1), two ReLU hidden layers and an identity affine readout.
global_derivation.independent_input_pair: Let the independent input pair be (u,v), representing signed input u-v.
global_derivation.output_pair: G(u,v)=max(1+u+v,2max(u,v)); H(u,v)=2max(u,v). The positive identity readout preserves this pair.
global_derivation.usual_input_split: At u=max(x,0) and v=max(-x,0), u+v=max(u,v)=|x|. Hence g=max(1+|x|,2|x|) and h=2|x| globally.
global_derivation.convexity_and_monotonicity: G,H are convex and coordinatewise nondecreasing in independent (u,v). Their usual-input pullbacks g,h are convex; neither is globally nondecreasing in signed x. They are nonnegative on the usual input split.
global_derivation.fold_signs: f has positive slope jumps at -1 and 1 and a negative jump at 0; g has positive jumps at -1,0,1; -h has its negative jump at 0. Caption markers agree.

code_review: The evaluator implements sign-split weights/biases, hidden (max(z+,z-),z-) gates, and the ungated affine readout. It checks exact original-versus-split recovery at every layer.
The executable main generates 601 rational inputs, closed-form checks, exact piecewise slopes, figures and source-bound construction metadata.
Independently invoked evaluate on all 601 saved CSV inputs: each row matches the evaluator and all three closed formulas, with exact Fraction arithmetic. No plotting/build routine was rerun.
Finite sample checks are kept distinct from the global algebraic proof above.
visual_review: Actual combined preview PNG inspected. Both panels and labels are legible with no clipping.
Original tent and exact polyline DC components use every breakpoint; displayed g and -h agree with the formula caption.
Blue circles mark the convex folds and orange triangles the concave folds at the correct coordinates.
Caption accurately distinguishes convex pullbacks in signed x from monotonicity in the independent input pair.
